{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party recognizes that globalization will continue shaping the future.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes the United States has the means to shape globalization so that it reflects the needs and values of the American people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes the United States has the responsibility to shape globalization so that it reflects the needs and values of the American people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore and the Democratic Party know they must be able to meet any military challenge from a position of dominance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore and the Democratic Party recognize there is a new security agenda consisting of threats that affect the entire world and transcend political borders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"During the past century, the Democratic Party has learned that avoiding war requires both strength to deter aggression and foresight to invest in peace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"It is time to apply the lesson of deterring aggression and investing in peace to the new global challenges.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party proposes a new strategy of Forward Engagement to guide conduct around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means addressing problems early in their development before they become crises.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means addressing problems as close to the source of the problem as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means having the forces and resources to deal with threats as soon after their emergence as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
